notes: In Spain, 'la tarde' runs from lunchtime (around 2 p.m.) until dinner or nightfall (around 8 or 9 p.m.), covering both English 'afternoon' and 'evening'.
Used in the standard greeting 'buenas tardes' (good afternoon / good evening).
